text: We deleted the feature our users said they loved most.
It was our onboarding checklist, and the numbers surprised us.
You're thinking: checklists work, every growth blog says so.
And in our survey, users rated it four out of five.
Then our designer watched ten new users try the app.
Seven of them ticked every box and never came back.
The checklist felt like progress, so for them it was the whole product.
So we cut it and put one real task on the first screen.
In week one, more people finished a real task.
Our support inbox got quieter, which made support nervous.
Here is my rule: a checklist measures effort, a first win measures value.
We deleted the feature users loved, and they finally loved the product.
